links.outcome: LLM accuracy on adult versus pediatric MedQA questions by model size
links.effect: Nano: 71.0% adult vs 55.4% pediatric (15.6-point gap, p<0.001); Mini: 81.5% vs 75.8% (p=0.001); full GPT-5: 86.3% vs 88.5% (p=0.138), gap eliminated.
links.quote: GPT-5 Nano exhibited a significant performance gap, with an accuracy of 71.0% in adult medicine versus 55.4% in pediatrics (a 15.6 percentage point difference, p<0.001).

unlisted_practices: Selecting larger model scale to close pediatric performance gap
Tiered implementation strategy based on task criticality

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM diagnostic performance across model sizes on pediatric vs. adult MedQA benchmark questions without testing deployment practices or safeguards.
